method: Inspected each generated cover and timed motion contact sheet, with export audit and matching-media hashes. Person FX were reviewed on a generated alpha silhouette over a dark stage; this is not real-footage quality evidence.
sourceMedia: Generated transparent person-shaped video; 320x180 neutral stage.
limitations: Does not establish real person cutout edge quality, natural motion, diverse body types, or complex footage performance.
Synthetic samples are sufficient only to review the preset visual treatments and effect distinction.

decisions.observation: The moving cutout keeps a visible sea-green halo around the head, arms and legs; it stays distinct from the brighter cyan and lime variants.
A warm amber-red halo is clearly visible around the moving figure and differs from the pink and green treatments.
A saturated magenta-violet outline remains legible through the sampled motion and reads as a narrow electric glow.
A broad soft rose halo is visible around the silhouette and is less sharp than the violet and neon treatments.
A wide deep-blue halo follows the silhouette; its hue and spread differ from the pale pearl treatment.
The bright green halo remains visible around the whole moving subject and is distinct from teal and cyan.
A pale blue-silver diffuse glow is now visible around the moving silhouette; it is softer and less saturated than the blue outline.
A compact cyan glow follows the moving outline and is brighter and tighter than the sea-green halo.
A subtle single trailing silhouette appears during movement without obscuring the main figure.
The motion leaves a clearly visible cool-blue offset echo behind the subject.
Several separated translucent silhouettes create a long, readable motion trail.
The subject produces discrete repeated silhouettes with a choppy rhythm, visibly separate from the smoother trails.
The movement leaves a soft, diffuse trailing figure that is lighter and less defined than the hard echoes.
The trailing silhouettes vary strongly in visibility, creating a distinct rhythmic echo treatment.
A short, crisp duplicate trails the moving figure; the trail is tighter than the long and dream variants.
A long translucent drift follows the figure, with a softer and more gradual fade than the crisp echoes.
The treated half has a clear warm amber skin and clothing cast against the unchanged source half.
The treated half shifts visibly toward cool cyan and blue-green compared with the original.
A strong violet-magenta cast is visible across the subject and differs from the rose and cinema looks.
A softer rose-magenta grade changes the subject color while retaining the scene contrast.
A fresh green-cyan grade is visible across the subject and is lighter than the cool and cinema variants.
The subject takes on a saturated gold stage look, distinct from the subtler warm portrait treatment.
The treated subject is visibly desaturated to silver monochrome compared with the original color half.
A darker teal-and-rose cinematic grade is visible on the treated subject and differs from the brighter cool look.
